newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's finance ministry names new head of credit.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's finance ministry names new head of credit.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday that Carlos Garcia Moreno Elizondo will be the the new director general of public credit.

It said Garcia Moreno Elizondo has a doctorate in economics from Cornell University, and is a specialist in external public debt issues. He previously worked for the Finance Ministry, Nacional Financiera, Petroleos Mexicanos and for private banks.
He replaces Carlos Mendoza, who will move to the Ministry of Transportation and Communications.
